sql: select count(*) as "count" from "leads" where "deleted_at" is null and "account_id" in (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "deleted_at" is null) and exists (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "crm_accounts"."id" = "leads"."account_id" and "archived_at" is null) and "ciudad" in ($1) and "estado" in ($2) and "tipo" in ($3) and "subtipo" in ($4) and "commercial_profile" in ($5) and "prioridad" in ($6) and "asignado_a" in ($7) and "assigned_user_email" in ($8)

select * from "leads" where "deleted_at" is null and "account_id" in (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "deleted_at" is null) and exists (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "crm_accounts"."id" = "leads"."account_id" and "archived_at" is null) and "ciudad" in ($1) and "estado" in ($2) and "tipo" in ($3) and "subtipo" in ($4) and "commercial_profile" in ($5) and "prioridad" in ($6) and "asignado_a" in ($7) and "assigned_user_email" in ($8) order by "fecha_creacion" desc, "id" desc limit $9 offset $10
